from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2ad7c8fc.py'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=grid[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    # Extend any repeated diagonal color alignment.
    from collections import Counter
    by=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts)
    for color,n in by.items():
        if n<2: continue
        cells=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if grid[r][c]==color]
        for (r1,c1),(r2,c2) in [(a,b) for i,a in enumerate(cells) for b in cells[i+1:]]:
            dr=r2-r1; dc=c2-c1
            if abs(dr)!=abs(dc) or dr==0: continue
            import math
            g=math.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc)); sr=dr//g; sc=dc//g
            if g<1: continue
            r,c=r1,c1
            while 0<=r-sr<len(grid) and 0<=c-sc<len(grid[0]): r-=sr; c-=sc
            while 0<=r<len(grid) and 0<=c<len(grid[0]):
                if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=color
                r+=sr; c+=sc
    return out
'''
